verses.text: Ahaz dey 20 years old when e begin to rule, and e rule 16 years for Jerusalem. E no do wetin right for di Lord eyes, like David im papa.
Because e waka for di ways of di kings of Israel, and make cast images for di Baals.
Plus dat one, e burn incense for di valley of Ben Hinnom and burn im pikin dem for fire, like di disgusting ways of di nations wey di Lord drive out before di pikin dem of Israel.
E make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places, for di hills and under every green tree.

So di Lord im God give am into di hand of di king of Syria. Dem beat am and carry plenty of im people as prisoners go Damascus. Dem give am also into di hand of di king of Israel, wey beat am with big killing.
Because Pekah, Remaliah pikin, kill 120,000 for Judah for one day, all of dem brave men, because dem don leave di Lord, di God of dem papa dem.
Zichri, one mighty man of Ephraim, kill Maaseiah, di king pikin, and Azrikam, wey be ruler of di palace, and Elkanah, wey dey next to di king.
Di pikin dem of Israel carry 200,000 of dem brothers as prisoners, women, sons and daughters, and dem take plenty things from dem too and carry di things go Samaria.

But one prophet of di Lord dey dere, im name na Oded. E go out to meet di army wey dey come Samaria and talk to dem say, “Look, because di Lord, di God of una papa dem, vex with Judah, e don give dem into una hand, and una don kill dem with anger wey reach heaven.
Now una wan make di pikin dem of Judah and Jerusalem become una male and female slaves. But no be so say una own sins dey too, against di Lord una God?
Now hear me, and send back di prisoners wey una take from una brothers, because di hot anger of di Lord dey on una.”

Den some of di heads of di pikin dem of Ephraim, Azariah, Johanan pikin, Berechiah, Meshillemoth pikin, Jehizkiah, Shallum pikin, and Amasa, Hadlai pikin, stand up against dem wey dey come from di war,

and talk to dem say, “Una no go bring dis prisoners come here, because una wan bring guilt on us before di Lord, to add to our sins and our guilt. Our guilt don big, and hot anger dey against Israel.”
So di armed men leave di prisoners and di things dem take before di princes and all di gathering.

Di men wey dem call by name stand up, take di prisoners and use di things dem take to cover all wey no get clothes among dem. Dem dress dem, give dem shoes, give dem food and drink, rub dem with oil, and put all di weak ones for donkeys and carry dem go Jericho, di city of palm trees, to dem brothers. Den dem return go Samaria.
For dat time King Ahaz send go meet di kings of Assyria make dem help am.
Because di Edomites don come again, beat Judah and carry prisoners go.

Di Philistines too don attack di cities of di low country and di South of Judah, and dem don take Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with im towns, Timnah with im towns and Gimzo with im towns, and dem dey stay there.
Because di Lord bring Judah low because of Ahaz, king of Israel, because e make Judah do anyhow and e do wrong well well against di Lord.
Tilgath Pilneser, king of Assyria, come to am and trouble am, but e no strengthen am.
Because Ahaz take some things from di house of di Lord and from di house of di king and of di princes and give am to di king of Assyria, but e no help am.
For di time of im trouble, dis same King Ahaz do wrong against di Lord even more.

Because e make sacrifice to di gods of Damascus, wey beat am. E talk say, “Because di gods of di kings of Syria dey help dem, I go make sacrifice to dem so that dem go help me.” But dem na im ruin and di ruin of all Israel.
Ahaz gather di vessels of God house and cut di vessels of God house to pieces. E close di doors of di Lord house and make altars for imself for every corner of Jerusalem.
For every city of Judah, e make high places to burn incense to other gods, and e make di Lord, di God of im papa dem, vex.
Now di rest of im acts and all im ways, from first to last, look, dem write dem for di book of di kings of Judah and Israel.
Ahaz die and dem bury am for di city, for Jerusalem, but dem no bring am enter di tombs of di kings of Israel. Hezekiah im pikin rule for im place.
Hezekiah dey 25 years old when e begin to rule, and e rule 29 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Abijah, Zechariah pikin.
E do wetin right for di Lord eyes, according to all wey David im papa don do.
For di first year of im rule, for di first month, e open di doors of di Lord house and repair dem.
E bring di priests and di Levites come and gather dem for di open place for di east,
and talk to dem say, “Hear me, una Levites. Make una make una self holy now, and make di house of di Lord, di God of una papa dem, holy, and carry di dirty things out of di holy place.
Because our papa dem don do wrong and do wetin bad for di eyes of di Lord our God. Dem don leave am, turn dem face from di place where di Lord dey stay, and turn dem back.
Dem don close di doors of di porch and put out di lamps, and dem no burn incense or offer burnt sacrifice for di holy place to di God of Israel.
So di anger of di Lord dey on Judah and Jerusalem, and e don make dem become something wey people dey fear, wey dem dey wonder at and laugh at, as una dey see with una eyes.
Look, our papa dem don fall by sword, and our sons, our daughters and our wives dey for prisoner because of dis.
Now e dey my heart to make covenant with di Lord, di God of Israel, so that im hot anger go turn away from us.
My sons, no relax now, because di Lord don choose una to stand before am, to serve am, and to be im ministers and burn incense.”

Den di Levites stand up: Mahath, Amasai pikin, and Joel, Azariah pikin, of di sons of di Kohathites. Of di sons of Merari, Kish, Abdi pikin, and Azariah, Jehallelel pikin. Of di Gershonites, Joah, Zimmah pikin, and Eden, Joah pikin.
Of di sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel. Of di sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah.
Of di sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei. Of di sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
Dem gather dem brothers and make dem self holy, and dem go in, according to di king command by di words of di Lord, to clean di Lord house.

Di priests go inside di Lord house to clean am, and dem bring out all di dirty things wey dem find for di Lord temple go di court of di Lord house. Di Levites take dem go carry dem out go Kidron stream.

Dem begin for di first day of di first month to make am holy, and for di eighth day of di month dem reach di porch of di Lord. Dem make di Lord house holy for eight days, and for di sixteenth day of di first month dem finish.

Den dem go meet King Hezekiah inside di palace and talk say, “We don clean all di Lord house, di altar of burnt sacrifice with all im vessels, and di table of di bread of di presence with all im vessels.
Also all di vessels wey King Ahaz throw away for im rule when e do wrong, we don prepare dem and make dem holy, and look, dem dey before di Lord altar.”
Den King Hezekiah wake early, gather di princes of di city and go up to di Lord house.
Dem bring seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs and seven male goats for sin offering for di kingdom, for di sanctuary and for Judah. E command di priests, Aaron sons, to offer dem on di Lord altar.
So dem kill di bulls, and di priests take di blood and sprinkle am on di altar. Dem kill di rams and sprinkle di blood on di altar. Dem kill di lambs too and sprinkle di blood on di altar.
Dem bring near di male goats for di sin offering before di king and di gathering, and dem put dem hands on dem,
and di priests kill dem and make sin offering with dem blood on di altar to cover sin for all Israel, because di king command say make dem do di burnt sacrifice and di sin offering for all Israel.
E put di Levites for di Lord house with cymbals, harps and lyres, according to di command of David, of Gad di king seer and of Nathan di prophet, because di command na from di Lord by im prophets.
Di Levites stand with David instruments, and di priests with di trumpets.
Hezekiah command say make dem offer di burnt sacrifice on di altar. As di burnt sacrifice begin, di song of di Lord begin too, with di trumpets and with di instruments of David, king of Israel.
All di gathering bow down, di singers sing and di trumpeters blow. All dis continue until di burnt sacrifice finish.
As dem finish to offer, di king and all wey dey with am bow down and worship.
Hezekiah di king and di princes command di Levites to sing praise to di Lord with di words of David and of Asaph di seer. Dem sing praises with gladness, and dem bow dem heads and worship.

Den Hezekiah talk say, “Now una don give una self to di Lord. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings come di Lord house.” Di gathering bring sacrifices and thank offerings, and all wey get willing heart bring burnt offerings.
Di number of di burnt offerings wey di gathering bring na 70 bulls, 100 rams and 200 lambs. All dis na burnt offering for di Lord.
Di things wey dem set apart na 600 bulls and 3,000 sheep.

But di priests too few, so dem no fit skin all di burnt offerings. So dem brothers di Levites help dem until di work finish and until di other priests don make dem self holy, because di Levites heart straight more than di priests to make dem self holy.
Di burnt offerings plenty too, with di fat of di peace offerings and di drink offerings for every burnt offering. So di service of di Lord house dey in order again.
Hezekiah and all di people rejoice because of wetin God don prepare for di people, because di thing happen sudden.
Hezekiah send go all Israel and Judah, and e write letters to Ephraim and Manasseh too, say make dem come di Lord house for Jerusalem to keep Passover to di Lord, di God of Israel.
Because di king, im princes and all di gathering for Jerusalem don agree to keep di Passover for di second month.
Because dem no fit keep am for dat time, because di priests never make dem self holy enough, and di people never gather for Jerusalem.
Di thing good for di eyes of di king and of all di gathering.

So dem make decision to send word through all Israel, from Beersheba reach Dan, say make dem come keep Passover to di Lord, di God of Israel, for Jerusalem, because dem never keep am plenty times as dem write am.

Di runners go with di letters from di hand of di king and im princes through all Israel and Judah, and according to di king command dem talk say, “Una pikin dem of Israel, return to di Lord, di God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, so that e go return to di rest of una wey escape from di hand of di kings of Assyria.
No be like una papa dem and una brothers, wey do wrong against di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, so that e give dem to ruin, as una dey see.
Now no make una neck hard like una papa dem. Give una self to di Lord and enter im sanctuary, wey e don make holy forever, and serve di Lord una God, so that im hot anger go turn away from una.

Because if una return to di Lord, una brothers and una pikin dem go find mercy before dem wey carry dem as prisoners, and dem go come back to dis land, because di Lord una God dey full of grace and mercy, and e no go turn im face away from una if una return to am.”
So di runners pass from city to city through di land of Ephraim and Manasseh, reach Zebulun, but dem laugh dem and mock dem.
Still, some men of Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humble dem self and come Jerusalem.
God hand dey on Judah too to give dem one heart to do di command of di king and of di princes by di word of di Lord.
Plenty people gather for Jerusalem to keep di Feast of Unleavened Bread for di second month, one very big gathering.
Dem stand up and remove di altars wey dey Jerusalem, and dem remove all di incense altars and throw dem go Kidron stream.
Den dem kill di Passover lamb for di fourteenth day of di second month. Di priests and di Levites feel shame, make dem self holy and bring burnt offerings come di Lord house.
Dem stand for dem place according to di law of Moses, di man of God. Di priests sprinkle di blood wey dem take from di hand of di Levites.
Because plenty people dey for di gathering wey never make dem self holy, so di Levites dey kill di Passover lamb for everybody wey no clean, to make am holy to di Lord.

Because plenty of di people, many from Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun, never clean dem self, yet dem eat di Passover no be as dem write am. But Hezekiah don pray for dem say, “Make di good Lord forgive everybody
wey set im heart to look for God, di Lord, di God of im papa dem, even if no be according to di cleaning of di sanctuary.”
Di Lord hear Hezekiah and heal di people.
Di pikin dem of Israel wey dey Jerusalem keep di Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with big gladness. Di Levites and di priests praise di Lord every day, dey sing to di Lord with loud instruments.
Hezekiah talk kind words to all di Levites wey sabi di service of di Lord. So dem eat for di feast seven days, dey offer peace offerings and dey confess to di Lord, di God of dem papa dem.
All di gathering agree to keep another seven days, and dem keep another seven days with gladness.
Because Hezekiah, king of Judah, give di gathering 1,000 bulls and 7,000 sheep for offerings, and di princes give di gathering 1,000 bulls and 10,000 sheep. Plenty priests make dem self holy.
All di gathering of Judah, with di priests and di Levites, and all di gathering wey come from Israel, and di foreigners wey come from Israel land and wey dey stay for Judah, rejoice.
So big joy dey for Jerusalem, because from di time of Solomon, David pikin, king of Israel, nothing like dis dey for Jerusalem.
Den di priests, di Levites, stand up and bless di people. Dem voice enter hear, and dem prayer reach im holy place, reach heaven.

When all dis finish, all Israel wey dey dere go out to di cities of Judah and break di pillars to pieces, cut down di Asherah poles and break down di high places and di altars from all Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim and Manasseh, until dem destroy all. Den all di pikin dem of Israel return, every man to im own land, to dem own cities.

Hezekiah arrange di groups of di priests and di Levites, every man according to im service, di priests and di Levites, for burnt offerings and peace offerings, to serve, to give thanks and to praise for di gates of di camp of di Lord.

E set di king own share from im property for di burnt offerings, di morning and evening burnt offerings, and di burnt offerings for di Sabbaths, di new moons and di set feasts, as dem write am for di law of di Lord.
E command di people wey dey Jerusalem to give di share of di priests and di Levites, so that dem go give dem self to di law of di Lord.
As soon as di command spread, di pikin dem of Israel give plenty of di first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey and all di harvest of di field, and dem bring plenty of di tenth of everything.

Di pikin dem of Israel and Judah wey dey stay for di cities of Judah, dem bring di tenth of cattle and sheep too, and di tenth of di holy things wey dem set apart to di Lord dem God, and dem put dem for heaps.
For di third month dem begin to lay di heaps, and dem finish for di seventh month.
When Hezekiah and di princes come see di heaps, dem bless di Lord and im people Israel.
Den Hezekiah ask di priests and di Levites about di heaps.

Azariah, di chief priest of Zadok house, answer am say, “Since people begin to bring di offerings come di Lord house, we don eat and enough us, and plenty still remain, because di Lord don bless im people, and wetin remain na dis big store.”
Den Hezekiah command say make dem prepare rooms for di Lord house, and dem prepare dem.
Dem bring di offerings, di tenth and di holy things with faith. Conaniah di Levite na ruler over dem, and Shimei im brother dey second.

Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath and Benaiah na overseers under di hand of Conaniah and Shimei im brother, by di order of King Hezekiah and Azariah, di ruler of God house.
Kore, Imnah pikin, di Levite, di gatekeeper for di east gate, dey over di freewill offerings of God, to share di offerings of di Lord and di most holy things.
Next to am na Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah and Shecaniah, for di cities of di priests, for dem trusted work, to give to dem brothers by groups, di big and di small.

Apart from dem wey dem count by family list among di males, from three years old go up, everybody wey dey enter di Lord house as di duty of every day need, for dem service for dem work according to dem groups,
and dem wey dem count by family list of di priests by dem papa houses, and di Levites from 20 years old go up, for dem work by dem groups,
and dem wey dem count by family list with all dem small pikin, dem wives, dem sons and dem daughters, through all di gathering, because for dem trusted work dem make dem self holy.

Also for Aaron sons di priests, wey dey di fields around dem cities, for every city men dey wey dem call by name to give share to all di males among di priests and to all wey dem count by family list among di Levites.
Hezekiah do dis through all Judah, and e do wetin good, right and faithful before di Lord im God.
For every work wey e begin for di service of God house, for di law and for di commands, to look for im God, e do am with all im heart and e prosper.
After dis things and dis faithfulness, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, come enter Judah and camp against di fortified cities, dey think to win dem for imself.
When Hezekiah see say Sennacherib don come and say e wan fight Jerusalem,
e take advice with im princes and im mighty men to block di water of di springs wey dey outside di city, and dem help am.
So plenty people gather and block all di springs and di stream wey dey flow through di land, dey talk say, “Why make di kings of Assyria come find plenty water?”
E take courage and build up all di wall wey break, raise am up to di towers, build another wall outside, make Millo for David city strong and make plenty weapons and shields.
E put war captains over di people and gather dem to am for di open place for di city gate and talk kind words to dem say,
“Be strong and brave. No fear and no shake because of di king of Assyria or because of all di plenty people wey dey with am, because one dey with us wey pass di one wey dey with am.
Na arm of flesh dey with am, but di Lord our God dey with us to help us and to fight our wars.” Di people rest on di words of Hezekiah, king of Judah.
After dis, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, dey Lachish with all im power, e send im servants go Jerusalem to Hezekiah, king of Judah, and to all Judah wey dey Jerusalem, say,
“Dis na wetin Sennacherib, king of Assyria, talk: ‘Wetin una dey trust wey una dey stay for Jerusalem under siege?
No be Hezekiah dey deceive una to give una to die by hunger and thirst, as e dey talk say di Lord our God go save us from di hand of di king of Assyria?
No be dis same Hezekiah don remove im high places and im altars and command Judah and Jerusalem say, “Una must worship before one altar and burn incense for am”?
Una no know wetin me and my papa dem don do to all di peoples of di lands? Di gods of di nations of dem lands fit save dem land from my hand?
Which one among all di gods of dem nations wey my papa dem destroy completely fit save im people from my hand, so that una God go fit save una from my hand?

So now no make Hezekiah deceive una or persuade una like dis, and no believe am, because no god of any nation or kingdom fit save im people from my hand and from di hand of my papa dem. How much less una God go save una from my hand?’”
Im servants talk more against di Lord God and against im servant Hezekiah.

E write letters too to insult di Lord, di God of Israel, and to talk against am say, “As di gods of di nations of di lands no save dem people from my hand, so di God of Hezekiah no go save im people from my hand.”
Dem shout with loud voice for Jews language to di people of Jerusalem wey dey di wall, to make dem fear and to trouble dem, so that dem go take di city.
Dem talk about di God of Jerusalem like di gods of di peoples of di earth, wey be work of man hands.
King Hezekiah and Isaiah di prophet, Amoz pikin, pray because of dis and cry go heaven.

Di Lord send angel, wey cut off all di brave mighty men, di leaders and di captains for di camp of di king of Assyria. So e return with shame go im own land. When e enter di house of im god, some of im own children kill am dere with sword.
So di Lord save Hezekiah and di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem from di hand of Sennacherib, king of Assyria, and from di hand of all others, and e guide dem on every side.
Plenty people bring gifts to di Lord for Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah, king of Judah, so that from dat time all di nations lift am up.
For dem days Hezekiah sick reach to die, and e pray to di Lord. E answer am and give am sign.
But Hezekiah no pay back according to di good wey dem do am, because im heart lift up. So anger come on am and on Judah and Jerusalem.
Still, Hezekiah humble imself for di pride of im heart, both e and di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem, so di anger of di Lord no come on dem for Hezekiah days.
Hezekiah get plenty plenty riches and honor, and e make store rooms for silver, gold, precious stones, spices, shields and all kind of fine things,
and houses for di harvest of grain, new wine and oil, and stalls for all kind of animals, and pens for flocks.
E build cities for imself too and get plenty flocks and herds, because God don give am plenty property.
Dis same Hezekiah block di upper spring of Gihon water and bring am straight down to di west side of David city. Hezekiah prosper for all im work.
But for di matter of di messengers of di princes of Babylon, wey dem send to am to ask about di wonder wey happen for di land, God leave am alone to test am, so that e go know all wey dey im heart.
Now di rest of Hezekiah acts and im good deeds, look, dem write dem for di vision of Isaiah di prophet, Amoz pikin, for di book of di kings of Judah and Israel.
Hezekiah die and dem bury am for di highest part of di tombs of David sons. All Judah and di people of Jerusalem honor am when e die. Manasseh im pikin rule for im place.
Manasseh dey 12 years old when e begin to rule, and e rule 55 years for Jerusalem.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, like di disgusting ways of di nations wey di Lord drive out before di pikin dem of Israel.
Because e build again di high places wey Hezekiah im papa don break down. E raise altars for di Baals, make Asherah poles, worship all di army of di sky and serve dem.
E build altars for di Lord house, where di Lord talk say, “For Jerusalem my name go dey forever.”
E build altars for all di army of di sky for di two courts of di Lord house.
E make im pikin dem pass through fire for di valley of Ben Hinnom. E practice magic, use charms and dey deal with spirit-callers and wizards. E do plenty evil for di Lord eyes to make am vex.

E put di carved image of di idol wey e make for God house, di house wey God talk about to David and to Solomon im pikin say, “For dis house and for Jerusalem, wey I don choose from all di tribes of Israel, I go put my name forever.
I no go again remove Israel foot from di land wey I don give una papa dem, if dem only go take care to do all wey I don command dem, all di law, di rules and di commands wey Moses give.”
Manasseh lead Judah and di people of Jerusalem go wrong, so dat dem do more evil pass di nations wey di Lord destroy before di pikin dem of Israel.
Di Lord talk to Manasseh and to im people, but dem no listen.
So di Lord bring on dem di captains of di army of di king of Assyria, wey take Manasseh with hooks, tie am with chains and carry am go Babylon.
When e dey for trouble, e beg di Lord im God and humble imself well well before di God of im papa dem.
E pray to am, and e hear im prayer and hear im begging, and bring am back to Jerusalem to im kingdom. Den Manasseh know say di Lord na God.

After dis, e build outer wall for David city, for di west side of Gihon, for di valley, reach di entrance of di Fish Gate. E go round Ophel with am and raise am very high. E put brave captains for all di fortified cities of Judah.
E remove di strange gods and di idol from di Lord house, and all di altars wey e build for di mountain of di Lord house and for Jerusalem, and throw dem outside di city.
E build di Lord altar again and offer peace offerings and thank offerings on am, and command Judah to serve di Lord, di God of Israel.
Still, di people dey make sacrifice for di high places, but to di Lord dem God only.
Now di rest of Manasseh acts, im prayer to im God and di words of di seers wey talk to am for di name of di Lord, di God of Israel, look, dem dey among di acts of di kings of Israel.

Im prayer too, and how God hear am, and all im sin and im wrong, and di places where e build high places and set up di Asherah poles and di carved images before e humble imself, look, dem write dem for di history of di seers.
So Manasseh die and dem bury am for im own house. Amon im pikin rule for im place.
Amon dey 22 years old when e begin to rule, and e rule two years for Jerusalem.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, as Manasseh im papa do. Amon make sacrifice to all di carved images wey Manasseh im papa make and serve dem.
E no humble imself before di Lord, as Manasseh im papa humble imself, but dis same Amon do more and more wrong.
Im servants plan against am and kill am for im own house.
But di people of di land kill all dem wey plan against King Amon, and di people of di land make Josiah im pikin king for im place.
Josiah dey eight years old when e begin to rule, and e rule 31 years for Jerusalem.
E do wetin right for di Lord eyes and waka for di ways of David im papa. E no turn to di right or to di left.

Because for di eighth year of im rule, while e still dey young, e begin to look for di God of David im papa. For di twelfth year e begin to clean Judah and Jerusalem from di high places, di Asherah poles, di carved images and di cast images.

Dem break down di altars of di Baals before am. E cut down di incense altars wey dey high above dem. E break di Asherah poles, di carved images and di cast images to pieces, make dem become dust and scatter am on di graves of dem wey make sacrifice to dem.
E burn di bones of di priests on dem altars and clean Judah and Jerusalem.
E do so for di cities of Manasseh, Ephraim and Simeon, reach Naphtali, for dem ruined places round.
E break down di altars, beat di Asherah poles and di carved images to powder, and cut down all di incense altars through all di land of Israel. Den e return go Jerusalem.

For di 18th year of im rule, when e don clean di land and di house, e send Shaphan, Azaliah pikin, Maaseiah, di ruler of di city, and Joah, Joahaz pikin, di recorder, to repair di house of di Lord im God.

Dem come to Hilkiah di high priest and give am di money wey dem bring come God house, wey di Levites, di gatekeepers, don collect from Manasseh and Ephraim, from all di rest of Israel, from all Judah and Benjamin and from di people of Jerusalem.
Dem give am to di workmen wey dey oversee di Lord house, and dem give am to di workmen wey dey work for di Lord house to repair di house.
Dem give am to di carpenters and di builders to buy cut stone and wood for joining and to make beams for di houses wey di kings of Judah don spoil.

Di men do di work faithfully. Di overseers over dem na Jahath and Obadiah, di Levites, of di sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of di sons of di Kohathites, to push di work forward. Other Levites too, all wey sabi music instruments,
dey over di carriers of load and dey push forward all wey do di work for every kind of service. Some of di Levites na secretaries, officers and gatekeepers.
When dem dey bring out di money wey dem bring come di Lord house, Hilkiah di priest find di book of di law of di Lord wey Moses give.
Hilkiah talk to Shaphan di secretary say, “I don find di book of di law for di Lord house.” Hilkiah give di book to Shaphan.
Shaphan carry di book go di king, and e bring word back to di king say, “All wey dem give to your servants, dem dey do am.
Dem don pour out di money wey dem find for di Lord house and give am into di hand of di overseers and into di hand of di workmen.”
Shaphan di secretary tell di king say, “Hilkiah di priest don give me one book.” Shaphan read am before di king.
When di king hear di words of di law, e tear im clothes.
Di king command Hilkiah, Ahikam, Shaphan pikin, Abdon, Micah pikin, Shaphan di secretary and Asaiah, di king servant, say,

“Go, ask di Lord for me and for dem wey remain for Israel and Judah about di words of di book wey dem find, because di anger of di Lord wey pour on us big, because our papa dem no keep di word of di Lord, to do all wey dem write for dis book.”

So Hilkiah and dem wey di king don command go meet Huldah di prophetess, wife of Shallum, Tokhath pikin, Hasrah pikin, wey dey keep di clothes. E dey stay for Jerusalem for di second part of di city. Dem talk to am about dis matter.
E talk to dem say, “Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: Tell di man wey send una to me say,
‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: Look, I go bring evil on dis place and on di people wey dey stay here, even all di curses wey dem write for di book wey dem read before di king of Judah.
Because dem don leave me and burn incense to other gods to make me vex with all di works of dem hands, my anger go pour on dis place and e no go quench.’
But to di king of Judah wey send una to ask di Lord, dis na wetin una go tell am: ‘Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: As for di words wey you don hear,

because your heart soft and you humble yourself before God when you hear im words against dis place and against di people wey dey stay here, and you humble yourself before me, tear your clothes and cry before me, I don hear you too, so di Lord talk.

Look, I go gather you to your papa dem, and dem go gather you to your grave in peace, and your eyes no go see all di evil wey I go bring on dis place and on di people wey dey stay here.’” Dem bring word back to di king.
Den di king send and gather all di elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

Di king go up to di Lord house, with all di men of Judah, di people of Jerusalem, di priests, di Levites and all di people, big and small. E read all di words of di book of di covenant wey dem find for di Lord house for dem ears.

Di king stand for im place and make covenant before di Lord, to waka after di Lord and keep im commands, im warnings and im rules with all im heart and all im soul, to do di words of di covenant wey dem write for dis book.
E make everybody wey dem find for Jerusalem and Benjamin agree to am. Di people of Jerusalem do according to di covenant of God, di God of dem papa dem.

Josiah remove all di disgusting things from all di lands wey belong to di pikin dem of Israel, and e make everybody wey dey Israel serve, even serve di Lord dem God. All im days dem no turn from following di Lord, di God of dem papa dem.
Josiah keep Passover to di Lord for Jerusalem, and dem kill di Passover lamb for di fourteenth day of di first month.
E put di priests for dem work and encourage dem for di service of di Lord house.

E talk to di Levites wey dey teach all Israel, wey dey holy to di Lord, say, “Put di holy ark for di house wey Solomon, David pikin, king of Israel, build. No more load go dey on una shoulders. Now serve di Lord una God and im people Israel.
Prepare una self by una papa houses, by una groups, according to di writing of David, king of Israel, and according to di writing of Solomon im pikin.
Stand for di holy place according to di divisions of di papa houses of una brothers, di pikin dem of di people, and make one part of a papa house of di Levites dey for each one.
Kill di Passover lamb, make una self holy and prepare for una brothers, to do according to di word of di Lord by Moses.”
Josiah give di pikin dem of di people from di flock lambs and young goats, all for di Passover offerings, for all wey dey dere, 30,000 in number, and 3,000 bulls. Dem come from di king property.

Im princes give freewill offering to di people, to di priests and to di Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah and Jehiel, di rulers of God house, give di priests 2,600 small animals and 300 bulls for di Passover offerings.
Conaniah too, and Shemaiah and Nethanel im brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad, di chiefs of di Levites, give di Levites 5,000 small animals and 500 bulls for di Passover offerings.
So di service dey ready, and di priests stand for dem place and di Levites for dem groups, according to di king command.
Dem kill di Passover lamb, di priests sprinkle di blood wey dem take from dem hand, and di Levites skin dem.

Dem remove di burnt offerings to give dem according to di divisions of di papa houses of di pikin dem of di people, to offer to di Lord, as dem write am for di book of Moses. Dem do di same with di bulls.
Dem roast di Passover lamb with fire according to di rule, and dem boil di holy offerings for pots, kettles and pans and carry dem quick quick to all di pikin dem of di people.

After dat dem prepare for dem self and for di priests, because di priests, Aaron sons, dey busy to offer di burnt offerings and di fat until night. So di Levites prepare for dem self and for di priests, Aaron sons.

Di singers, Asaph sons, dey for dem place according to di command of David, Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun di king seer, and di gatekeepers dey every gate. Dem no need to leave dem service, because dem brothers di Levites prepare for dem.
So all di service of di Lord ready for dat same day, to keep di Passover and to offer burnt offerings on di Lord altar, according to King Josiah command.
Di pikin dem of Israel wey dey dere keep di Passover for dat time and di Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days.

No Passover like dat one dey for Israel since di days of Samuel di prophet. No king of Israel keep Passover like di one wey Josiah keep, with di priests, di Levites, all Judah and Israel wey dey dere and di people of Jerusalem.
Na for di 18th year of Josiah rule dem keep dis Passover.
After all dis, when Josiah don prepare di temple, Neco, king of Egypt, go up to fight Carchemish by di Euphrates, and Josiah go out to meet am.

But e send messengers to am say, “Wetin I get to do with you, you king of Judah? I no come against you today, but against di house wey I dey fight. God don command me to hurry. Stop to fight God, wey dey with me, so that e no go destroy you.”
Still, Josiah no turn im face from am, but e change im look to fight am. E no listen to Neco words wey come from God mouth, and e come fight for di valley of Megiddo.
Di archers shoot King Josiah, and di king talk to im servants say, “Carry me go, because I don get serious wound.”
So im servants take am out of di chariot, put am for di second chariot wey e get, and bring am go Jerusalem. E die and dem bury am for di tombs of im papa dem. All Judah and Jerusalem cry for Josiah.

Jeremiah sing sorrow song for Josiah, and all di singing men and singing women talk about Josiah for dem sorrow songs till today. Dem make am rule for Israel, and look, dem write dem for di Lamentations.
Now di rest of Josiah acts and im good deeds, according to wetin dem write for di law of di Lord,
and im acts, from first to last, look, dem write dem for di book of di kings of Israel and Judah.
Den di people of di land take Jehoahaz, Josiah pikin, and make am king for im papa place for Jerusalem.
Jehoahaz dey 23 years old when e begin to rule, and e rule three months for Jerusalem.
Di king of Egypt remove am for Jerusalem and fine di land 100 talents of silver and one talent of gold.
Di king of Egypt make Eliakim im brother king over Judah and Jerusalem and change im name to Jehoiakim. Neco take Joahaz im brother and carry am go Egypt.
Jehoiakim dey 25 years old when e begin to rule, and e rule 11 years for Jerusalem. E do wetin bad for di eyes of di Lord im God.
Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, come up against am and tie am with chains to carry am go Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar carry some of di vessels of di Lord house go Babylon too and put dem for im temple for Babylon.
Now di rest of Jehoiakim acts, di disgusting things wey e do and wetin dem find against am, look, dem write dem for di book of di kings of Israel and Judah. Jehoiachin im pikin rule for im place.
Jehoiachin dey eight years old when e begin to rule, and e rule three months and ten days for Jerusalem. E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes.
For di turn of di year, King Nebuchadnezzar send and bring am go Babylon with di fine vessels of di Lord house, and e make Zedekiah im brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
Zedekiah dey 21 years old when e begin to rule, and e rule 11 years for Jerusalem.
E do wetin bad for di eyes of di Lord im God. E no humble imself before Jeremiah di prophet, wey dey talk from di Lord mouth.
E rebel against King Nebuchadnezzar too, wey don make am swear by God. But e make im neck hard and im heart strong against turning to di Lord, di God of Israel.
Also all di chiefs of di priests and di people do wrong well well, following all di disgusting ways of di nations, and dem make di Lord house wey e don make holy for Jerusalem dirty.
Di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, send to dem by im messengers, dey wake early dey send dem, because e get pity for im people and for im dwelling place.
But dem mock God messengers, dey look down on im words and laugh at im prophets, until di anger of di Lord rise against im people, until no cure dey again.

So e bring on dem di king of di Chaldeans, wey kill dem young men with sword for di house of dem sanctuary, and e no get pity on young man or young woman, old man or person wey bend for old age. E give all of dem into im hand.
All di vessels of God house, big and small, di treasures of di Lord house and di treasures of di king and of im princes, all dis e carry go Babylon.
Dem burn God house, break down di wall of Jerusalem, burn all im palaces with fire and destroy all im fine vessels.
E carry go Babylon dem wey escape di sword, and dem become servants to am and to im sons until di kingdom of Persia begin to rule,
to fulfill di word of di Lord by di mouth of Jeremiah, until di land enjoy im Sabbaths. As long as e dey empty, e keep Sabbath, to complete 70 years.

Now for di first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, so that di word of di Lord by di mouth of Jeremiah go happen, di Lord wake up di spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia, so that e send word through all im kingdom, and e write am too, say,

“Dis na wetin Cyrus, king of Persia, talk: ‘Di Lord, di God of heaven, don give me all di kingdoms of di earth, and e don command me to build house for am for Jerusalem, wey dey Judah. Anybody among una wey belong to im people, make di Lord im God dey with am, and make e go up.’”
